speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim (Aljunied)
text: I have three supplementary questions for the Minister for National Development.

speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim (Aljunied)
text: The first question is, is the Government aware that there are residents who have contracted to sell their existing homes in the expectation of moving to their new homes by a certain timeline before the circuit breaker measures were announced?

speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim (Aljunied)
text: Some of these residents would, therefore, be impacted in the sense that if their new homes are not ready for them to move in by the designated time to leave their current homes, they would have to find alternative accommodation.

speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim (Aljunied)
text: The second question is, I am glad the Minister has said that the authorities would be prepared to exercise flexibility in granting shorter term rentals.

speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim (Aljunied)
text: Would he be able to also assure Singaporeans that URA and HDB would aim to give timely replies to such applications, for example, say within a week, because time is of the essence in such cases?

speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim (Aljunied)
text: According to the phases announced, works by individual households are placed in tier D, which I think is a tier that is termed "can be delayed".

speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim (Aljunied)
text: It is indicated that such works may only resume in August.

speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim (Aljunied)
text: Based on Minister's statements in press conferences, I would like him to confirm that even if the works are in a phase that BCA is not prioritising, if the contractors can show that they are able to comply with BCA's safety requirements, that BCA would consider such applications even if they are in the subsequent tiers for earlier resumption or commencement.

speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
text: That is why we have a series of different measures to help these families and homeowners.

speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
text: It was in the first few days of the circuit breaker that we provided for such an exemption.

speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
text: But still, there are quite a number who could not complete the renovation works during that few days and then, these had to be suspended.

speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
text: For these cases, we have worked on a different set of measures.

speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
text: We will continue to do whatever we can to assist them.

speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
text: On the third question on when the renovation works can resume, we are doing it in two steps.

speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
text: I have the measures in place and I would like to be prioritised ahead in Phase One", we will be prepared to consider such cases as well.
